title: Consciousness is a biological feature of certain organisms

statements.text: On the scientific world picture, the world is made of particles organized into systems, some systems are living, and some living systems have evolved brains that cause and sustain consciousness. Consciousness is a biological feature of certain organisms in the same sense in which photosynthesis, mitosis, digestion and reproduction are.

sources.locator: p. 6, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, pp. 92-93
sources.quote: Consciousness is, thus, a biological feature of certain organisms
